# Ferry

> Ferry is a Manifest V3 browser extension that exports ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini conversations to clean Markdown and into Obsidian, Notion and GitHub. Conversion runs locally in the browser; Ferry's servers never receive conversation content.

Ferry is made by Techcesories LLC (Georgia, USA). Current version: 0.10.0. The free tier exports the conversation you are viewing to Markdown, JSON, PDF, the clipboard, or an Obsidian vault. Gemini support is optional: the user clicks "Allow Gemini" and approves access to gemini.google.com. Ferry Pro adds a full-history export of every ChatGPT or Claude chat to one ZIP, multi-chat export, Context Packs, code blocks saved as real files, and direct export to Notion and GitHub using the user's own keys.

Pricing: free tier, then Pro at $19.99 per year (auto-renews, cancel any time) or one-time passes of 1 month $2.99, 3 months $7.99 and 6 months $12.99. Every purchase has a 30-day money-back guarantee.

Why people use it: when switching AI assistants. Claude's import brings over a memory summary, not conversations. Gemini can import full chats from ChatGPT and Claude but can't export them in a portable format. Ferry exports chats as Markdown files that any assistant or notes app can read.

## Guides
- [Export ChatGPT to Markdown](https://ferry.techcesories.com/export-chatgpt-to-markdown/): OpenAI's data export with a conversion script, versus one-click export.
- [Export Claude to Obsidian](https://ferry.techcesories.com/export-claude-to-obsidian/): copy and paste, Claude's data export, or one click into an Obsidian vault.
- [Save ChatGPT and Claude to Notion](https://ferry.techcesories.com/chatgpt-claude-to-notion/): paste, Markdown import, or direct to a Notion page with an integration key.
- [Export Gemini chats to Markdown](https://ferry.techcesories.com/export-gemini-chats-to-markdown/): Google Takeout (My Activity, Gemini Apps) and its limits, versus one-click export.

## Policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://ferry.techcesories.com/privacy/): local conversion, every permission explained, one licensing server that receives a random install ID (and an email only for Restore Pro).
- [Terms of Service](https://ferry.techcesories.com/terms/): licensing, billing, the 30-day refund policy, and Georgia governing law.

## Key facts
- Product type: browser extension (Manifest V3), version 0.10.0
- Install: Chrome Web Store, https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/jccpfaknkdpnekdhgchkildnmphgmgao
- Browsers: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc. Not yet available for Firefox or Safari.
- Operating systems: Windows, macOS, Linux
- Supported sources: ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google, optional permission)
- Export formats: Markdown, JSON, PDF
- Destinations: local files, clipboard, Obsidian, Notion, GitHub
- Data: conversations are converted in the browser and not sent to Ferry. Settings and keys are stored locally in the browser, never uploaded. The only Ferry server is a license check (ferry-api.techcesories.workers.dev).
- Affiliation: independent product, not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, or Mozilla
- Contact: contactus@techcesories.com
